additionalProperties.description: A built-in action, by its id.

confirm.description: The dialog that confirms the action, over the action facts; empty asks nothing.

copy.description: What running the action gives the person to paste elsewhere, on an action whose only effect is its copy (copy_review_request): the client puts it on the clipboard, or shows it where it cannot. Its texts run over the copy facts of the unit the action runs on (`{{.copy.title}}`, `{{.copy.link}}`, `{{.copy.brief.goal}}`); `html` escapes a value and `replace` swaps a substring (`{{replace .copy.title "`" "'"}}`).

html.description: The same text formatted as HTML, which a rich paste target reads; empty copies the plain text alone.

notice.description: What the client says once it copied, over the copy facts. Required.

text.description: The plain text copied, over the copy facts. Required.

input.description: The text the action asks for.

help.description: What to write, shown in the empty input.

note.description: What the action would do on this row, over the action facts.

summary.description: One line, what pressing it does: its tooltip and help line. Required.

warning.description: Shown under the action, over the action facts; empty shows nothing.

why.description: Why the action is disabled, over the action facts.
